verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs say you can self-compile GitLab and that the raw OpenAPI spec lives in the GitLab monorepo, which implies the source is publicly readable. A community member describes GitLab as open source at its core and forkable. However, no first-party evidence names the open license or how much of the product it covers. Missing for 10: first-party statement of the open-source license, clarity on which editions/features are open versus proprietary, a link to the public source repository.
